{{Quote|Mand'alor has kept his word. A transport has arrived bearing Jedi prisoners. The war has not even begun in earnest, and yet I have my first subjects. I will continue as before, categorizing differences in Jedi versus base members of their species. These are meager pickings to begin with. A Rodian and another human.|Demagol's Journal|<ref name="TSJODD">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/demagol/index.html?page=1|text="The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol"|int=The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol (article)|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>}}
In [[3964 BBY]], a '''[[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]''' was one of the first of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]] to be captured by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and sent to [[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station|Flashpoint Station]]. There, the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]] experimented on the Rodian, along with the Jedi's [[Human/Legends|Human]] companion, trying to discover the secret of the Jedi Order's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities. The Rodian did not survive long before Demagol's investigations [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Jedi.<ref name="TSJODD" />
